summary.intent: Clean up code via a simplify pass, add cost visibility to the `entire improve` command, fix `insights` and `improve` commands showing all-zero scores and no patterns, then make insights more useful with better scoring and tool usage tracking.
summary.outcome: All four goals completed and committed: code cleaned up (deduped functions, fixed UTF-8 truncation, DRY'd tracker), cost display added to `entire improve`, on-demand summary backfilling implemented so insights/improve work without pre-existing summaries, token efficiency scoring fixed (was always 0), improve pattern detection switched from exact-match SQL to keyword-theme analyzer, and a new tool_calls table added to surface tool usage in insights.

repo: Sessions created before summarization was enabled have no summaries in checkpoint metadata, causing all scoring dimensions to show zero — insights/improve must backfill summaries on demand.
`nullableFloat` stored 0.0 scores as SQL NULL, making 'not computed' indistinguishable from a real zero score — score columns should store 0.0 directly.

`QueryRecurringFriction` used exact text matching against friction strings that are always unique full sentences — it never produces matches. `AnalyzePatterns` (keyword-theme grouping) was already implemented but unused.
Token efficiency scoring used a ~8k tokens/file baseline; real sessions use 300k–6M tokens/file, so the score was always 0. Fixed to use tokens-per-turn with a realistic baseline.
`gofmt` repeatedly strips trailing `//nolint:ireturn` comments from function signatures in capabilities.go; the nolint fix from one commit was never actually staged/committed.
The `summarize` package's `Entry.ToolName` and `Entry.ToolDetail` fields provide per-turn tool call data usable for extracting tool usage counts from transcripts.
`termstyle.TotalTokens` recursively includes subagent tokens; the inline `InputTokens + OutputTokens` calculation in insights_cmd.go was missing subagent tokens.

code.finding: Schema version bumped for new `has_summary INTEGER DEFAULT 0` column on sessions table and new `tool_calls` table (checkpoint_id, session_index, tool_name, count).
`nullableFloat` helper removed; `HasSummary bool` added to `SessionRow`; `insertToolCalls` added; `UpdateSessionSummary` added for backfill path.
Theme keyword lists expanded with real-world patterns (api, ci, conflict, review, etc.); `maxFrictionExamples = 10` cap added to prevent unbounded LLM prompt growth.
Token efficiency rewritten to use tokens-per-turn ratio; focus score rewritten with gaussian curve; friction penalty changed from 20 to 15 per item.

`backfillSummaries` function added — queries sessions with `has_summary=false`, generates summaries via Claude, updates cache. Wired into both `runInsights` and `runImprove`. Tool extraction via `extractToolCounts` added to cache refresh loop.
`Execute` signature changed to return `(string, *UsageInfo, error)` where `UsageInfo` carries `InputTokens`, `OutputTokens`, `TotalCostUSD` parsed from Claude CLI JSON response.

Switched both dry-run and full run to use `AnalyzePatterns` (theme grouping) instead of `buildFrictionPatterns` (exact SQL match). `attachTranscriptExcerpts` updated to use `AffectedSessions` from pattern directly. Cost display added via `renderUsageLine`.

Removed duplicated `totalTokensFromUsage` function; replaced with `termstyle.TotalTokens()`. Also resolved merge conflict keeping session scoring block from branch and `writeOpts` variable + v2 dual-write from main.

Requires `//nolint:ireturn // <explanation>` on each interface-returning function. The `nolintlint` linter enforces both specific linter names and explanatory text. gofmt does NOT strip these comments — they were simply missing from the committed state.

workflow: When `replace_all` is used on a function name that appears in both its definition and its calls, it renames the definition too — requiring a follow-up edit to restore the function name.
Pre-commit hooks or gofmt runs can silently revert edits if files aren't staged before the format step runs.
The Claude CLI `--output-format json` response includes `total_cost_usd` and `usage.input_tokens`/`output_tokens` fields directly parseable for cost tracking.
Backfilling summaries at query time (rather than requiring a prior summarize run) is the right UX — commands should be self-sufficient, not depend on prior automation having run.

friction: `gofmt` was blamed multiple times for stripping `//nolint:ireturn` comments, causing repeated re-add cycles across multiple commits — actual cause was that the file was never staged in the first commit that was supposed to fix it.
`nolintlint` linter requires both the specific linter name (`ireturn`) and explanatory text in nolint directives, causing lint failures after adding bare `//nolint:ireturn` comments.
capabilities.go nolint fix from the simplify commit was not actually included in that commit, so the same lint errors resurfaced in the next session.
`improve --dry-run` showed 0 patterns for weeks because `AnalyzePatterns` was implemented but wired to nothing — `runImprove` was calling the exact-match SQL path instead.
The `replace_all` edit on `totalTokensFromUsage` renamed the function definition as well as its call sites, requiring a follow-up fix.
Friction grouping defaults to 'other' for items not matching known theme keywords — the theme keyword lists needed manual expansion to be useful.
open_items: `statusStyles` wrapper in `status_style.go` adds indirection over `termstyle.Styles` — could be removed but requires refactoring `status.go`.
`termstyle.TotalTokens` lives in the presentation package but performs data computation — should move to `agent` or a utility package.
N+1 query pattern in `insightsdb/queries.go` `populateDenormalized` — 3 extra queries per session row (friction, learnings, tool_calls).
Stringly-typed status/priority/direction values across packages — would benefit from typed constants or enums.
Tool counts in `tool_calls` table only populate for sessions summarized after this change; existing sessions won't have tool data until re-summarized or cache is cleared.
Theme keyword coverage for `AnalyzePatterns` is manually maintained — friction items not matching any theme fall through to 'other' and may be missed by `improve`.
